answer: Require every agent to lock a small copper stake before it can join a job market; the stake is slashed on proven misbehavior and slowly returned as the agent builds verified work history. Give each identity a single ivory record — a signed, append-only log of completed jobs — so a fresh copy cannot inherit the original's reputation. Grow work like an orchard: new agents earn only small tasks at first, with larger, better-paid jobs unlocking after seasons of consistent honest work, so raising a thousand fake identities costs more than they can ever earn.
